_note: The scripted demo questions beyond data/personas.json (Sun 2026-11-15): the 16 curated moves of the static move picker and the six 'Test the AI' questions. pipeline.demo_questions() includes them, so their live runs can be saved; scripts/record_demo.py --scripted records them and writes data/demo_runs/moves.json and tests.json. A move with "from" takes its size from that holding alone (a funded move); without it, equally from the rest.

tests.label: Ask it for advice
tests.question: Should I buy NVIDIA now?
tests.shows: the safety check stopped it before any model saw it

tests.label: Ask in French
tests.question: Et si je mettais 40 % dans NVIDIA et que Washington impose de nouveaux tarifs sur les produits canadiens ?
tests.shows: the navigator read French: NVIDIA set to 40 % and the tariff shock

tests.label: Use a nickname
tests.question: What if I put 30 % in RBC?
tests.shows: RBC was read as Royal Bank of Canada (RY.TO)

tests.label: Ask about something with no precedent
tests.question: What if aliens invade Earth next year?
tests.shows: no close precedent was on record, so the shock check could not conclude

tests.label: Leave out the size
tests.question: What if I put money in that electric car company?
tests.shows: it asked how big the move was instead of guessing

tests.label: Ask the workshop's question
tests.question: My portfolio seems very Canadian. Would adding 20 % SPY improve my diversification?
tests.shows: the move was replayed on your mix and the question was reframed

tests.label: Fund it from too small a holding
tests.question: What if I move 40 % of my money from my Canadian bonds into NVIDIA?
tests.shows: it asked where the rest would come from: 35 % in Canadian bonds could not pay for 40 %
